data.additional_information:
Company Overview –
Samsung Electronics is a global leader in consumer electronics, semiconductors, telecommunications, and
digital media technologies. The company was founded in 1969. Samsung R&D Institute India-Delhi (SRI-Delhi),
was established in 2002 as a global research center of Samsung Visual Display (VD) division. At present, it has
become one of the largest centers of Visual Display (VD) for Global Smart TVs commercialization for
Samsung. SRI-Delhi is a key contributor to Software development on Samsung's global products, such as
Smart TVs, Large Format Display (LFDs) and home appliances. It provides continuous support for entire
ecosystem; Platform, Middleware and Applications along with other domains as follows:
a. Advance Research (Vision AI, Voice AI, Business Intelligence, Predictive Analytics)
b. Tizen Platform development
c. Smart TV and B2B Products & Services
d. IoT, Connectivity & Convergence
e. Cloud Platform, Smart Hub Server Development and Operation


Job Overview –
As a PhD intern, you will be tasked with developing differentiated solutions and approaches that are at the
forefront of AI technology. This internship offers a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge research,
collaborate with industry experts, and make a tangible impact on the development of advanced AI systems
Roles & Responsibilities –
• Design and implement On-device AI solutions that optimize AI models for efficient performance on
devices.
• Develop Smaller Vision Language Models that achieve state-of-the-art accuracy while maintaining
efficiency.
• Enhance Sensing AI capabilities by developing algorithms for interpreting sensor data and improving
system perception.
• Innovate and propose new approaches to address challenges in AI research and development.
• Collaborate with team members to design, implement, and test advanced AI solutions.
• Document research findings and contribute to technical reports and presentations.
• Stay informed about the latest advancements in AI and integrate new knowledge into ongoing
projects


Skills & Experience Required –
• Currently pursuing a PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field and thesis
should be submitted.
• Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing.
• Experience with vision models and understanding of computer vision techniques.
• Proficiency in AI frameworks and tools such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.
• Strong programming skills in Python or other relevant languages.
• Experience with on-device AI or edge computing is a plus.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as in a team.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex ideas clearly
data.additional_details: Thesis must be submitted & final degree expected in 2026 itself.
